# DiggerChain

> A terminal expedition through a castle beneath a forest. Offline native play, a practice-only browser demo, and an external-agent text interface. English throughout.

The alpha expedition has three floors and 512 successful actions. Alpha has no direct token payouts. Beta is planned to introduce points for a future airdrop. Direct $DCG and supported RWA-token rewards are planned for Phase III, the full release. The browser demo is practice only. The planned token is $DCG on Robinhood Chain, chain ID 4663, with a PonsFamily launch alongside alpha. Official contract address: {{TOKEN_ADDRESS}}

## Documentation

- [Complete site context](./llms-full.txt): Full player guide, game rules, native/headless behavior, token status, links, and current availability.
- [Player guide](./docs.md): The actual website documentation, exported as Markdown from the same source as the human-readable guide.
- [Lore](./lore.md): The full eight-page story, exported from the illustrated book. Fiction is separate from current playable scope.
- [Roadmap](./roadmap.md): Five phases without dates, from alpha to a potential DiggerChain network.
- [Public site configuration](./site.json): Canonical published token address and project URLs; null means Coming Soon.

- [Home](./index.html#home): Title screen, native download, and token address.
